entry.name: updateInterval
entry.label: Refresh interval of the monitored values in milliseconds.

entry.name: graphDuration
entry.label: Amount of history shown in the rolling graphs, in seconds.

entry.name: sectionOrder
entry.label: Display order of the section cards.

entry.name: showHostCard
entry.label: Show the host card with the machine name and clock.

entry.name: clock24
entry.label: Use a 24-hour clock.

entry.name: clockSeconds
entry.label: Show seconds in the clock.

entry.name: showDate
entry.label: Show the date under the clock.

entry.name: showCpu
entry.label: Show the CPU section.

entry.name: showPerCore
entry.label: Show per-core usage tiles inside the CPU section.

entry.name: showCpuGraph
entry.label: Show the rolling CPU usage graph.

entry.name: showTemp
entry.label: Show CPU temperature when sensors are available.

entry.name: showMemory
entry.label: Show the memory section.

entry.name: showNetwork
entry.label: Show the network section.

entry.name: showNetGraph
entry.label: Show the rolling download graph.

entry.name: showDisk
entry.label: Show the disk section.

entry.name: showDiskRates
entry.label: Show the disk read/write rate row.

entry.name: showGpu
entry.label: Show the GPU section when a GPU is detected.

entry.name: showGpuTemp
entry.label: Show GPU temperature next to each usage percentage.

entry.name: showVram
entry.label: Show the VRAM row for each GPU.

entry.name: showBattery
entry.label: Show the battery section (laptops).

entry.name: miniMode
entry.label: Start in mini mode (compact card with percentages only; click expands).

entry.name: cornerRadius
entry.label: Corner radius of the widget silhouette in pixels.

entry.name: cardRadius
entry.label: Corner radius of the inner glass cards in pixels.

entry.name: styleMode
entry.label: Widget material style: 0 = liquid glass, 1 = solid panel.

entry.name: appearance
entry.label: Color scheme: 0 = dark, 1 = light, 2 = follow system.

entry.name: density
entry.label: Layout density: 0 = comfortable, 1 = compact.

entry.name: accentColor
entry.label: Accent color used by meters, graphs and tiles.

entry.name: cpuColor
entry.label: Custom CPU color; empty follows the accent.

entry.name: memoryColor
entry.label: Custom memory color; empty follows the accent.

entry.name: netDownColor
entry.label: Custom download color; empty follows the accent.

entry.name: netUpColor
entry.label: Custom upload color; empty follows a lighter accent.

entry.name: gpuColor
entry.label: Custom GPU color; empty follows the accent.

entry.name: blurRadius
entry.label: Strength of the frosted-glass blur in pixels.

entry.name: tintStrength
entry.label: Strength of the glass tint in percent.

entry.name: refraction
entry.label: Enable the refractive edge of the liquid glass.

entry.name: realtimeRefraction
entry.label: Continuously resample the background (needed for animated wallpapers, uses more power).

entry.name: shadowEnabled
entry.label: Draw the floating drop shadow.

entry.name: shadowStrength
entry.label: Opacity of the drop shadow in percent.
